No case-specific ALOS-2 PALSAR-2 full-resolution product was downloadable from the public links inspected in this pass. The Ennore spill began 2017-01-28. Search JAXA AUIG2/G-Portal for ALOS-2 PALSAR-2 observations over 12.9-13.6 N, 80.0-80.7 E around 2017-01-28 through 2017-02-05; inspect polarization before ordering/downloading. ALOS-1 PALSAR had already ended before 2017, so this case requires ALOS-2/PALSAR-2. JAXA public ScanSAR L2.2 can provide 25 m backscatter and is a mixture of single- and dual-pol; it is not guaranteed to be quad-pol or to be an exact spill-date scene. Search/download entry: https://auig2.jaxa.jp/ and https://gportal.jaxa.jp/ .
